title: Why might unmet needs increase over time even when difficulties stay stable or decline?
text: Movement on the two indices does not always track together, and a rise in unmet need can reflect a change in circumstance rather than worsening cognition. Support structures that surround active treatment often fall away once treatment ends, demands such as returning to work can increase, and growing awareness of cognitive change can itself surface needs that were not previously articulated. For this reason, change between administrations is best read in the context of the respondent’s situation, and the report describes that movement in plain language without applying a statistical change-score label.
